1.consolidated_definition: Travesura, fechoría, delito. “Lo metieron a la cárcel por esa pehnetura.” Existe la variante perneta. Posiblemente derivado de pernear, ‘impacientarse, irritarse por no conseguir lo que se desea’. Dicc. Acad.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mischief, misdeed, crime. "He was put in jail for that pehnetura." There is a variant perneta. Possibly derived from pernear, 'to become impatient or irritated because one cannot obtain what one desires'. Dicc. Acad.
